# Will your Actions schedule run when you think it will?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every schedule cron that is invalid, faster than GitHub's 5-minute minimum, or pinned to the top of the hour where scheduled runs get delayed. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [GitHub Actions schedule cron: why runs are late, and which minute to pick](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/actions-schedule-check/github-actions-schedule-cron-delays.html)
